name: R3B_READY_SOFT_GRACE
mechanism: Availability exit hysteresis after confirmed ready; explicit new policy, not a compatibility bug fix
branch_rules: G uses prediction angle and eta correction rate; V uses prediction angle and both correction rates. Strict good refreshes last_good; grace never refreshes it. Any hard failure, larger soft excursion, third soft packet or elapsed beyond0.10 immediately revokes and requires20strict-good frames again.
known_risk: Alternating good and soft failures may extend readiness; all held outputs and severe errors must be reported. No claim two-frame grace will attain5s.
stop_rule: One fixed grace setting, no sweep of frame count/time/factor. Assess development3real conditions plus negative/recovery behavior before any final freeze.
floating_time_boundary: deadline=std::nextafter(last_strict_good + 0.10, +infinity); time<=deadline; next representable value above deadline rejected; one ULP predeclared, no post-hoc tolerance
